name: U-Tech Media Corporation
summary: U-Tech Media Corporation specializes in the fabrication and distribution of pre-recorded optical media. Their extensive offerings include replication services for various disc formats, such as Blu-ray, DVD, and CD, catering to both video and audio content, as well as data storage (CD-ROMs and DVD-ROMs). In addition to manufacturing, U-Tech provides comprehensive authoring solutions, encompassing services like computer graphics, video editing, and audio-visual encoding and authoring. They also offer specialized components and services, such as stamper production, data transfer rate discs, and test discs. Completing their service suite are packaging solutions and diverse printing options, including silk screen and off-set techniques. The company was founded in 1999 and operates from its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
